read.en: Teradyne fell 3.3% on Nov 19 to $227.43, trading $226.65–249.00 on light volume (0.63x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($235.7), 10-day ($241.7), 30-day ($291.9), 100-day ($349.2) and 200-day ($349.7), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($222.89), and RSI is 33.5.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月19日下跌 3.3%，收于 $227.43，盘中区间 $226.65–249.00，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.63 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$235.7）、10 日（$241.7）、30 日（$291.9）、100 日（$349.2）和 200 日均线（$349.7）下方，五者均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$222.89），RSI 为 33.5。

read.en: The $249.00 high cleared the $237.6–246 resistance intraday but reversed, and the close broke the $228.9–231.9 support (Nov 18 low, Nov 16 low and close), now resistance. Resistance is $228.9–231.9, then $235.7–240.5 (5-day, Nov 16–18 highs) and $241.7–249 (10-day, Nov 19 high). Support is $222.5–222.9 (SAR, Nov 9 and 17 lows), then $211.6–212.7. A close above $231.9 would target $235.7–240.5; below $222.5, $212.
